newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Birch sees NZ unemployment rate close to 5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Birch sees NZ unemployment rate close to 5 percent.

text.p: New Zealand Finance Minister Bill Birch told Reuters Financial Television in Fukuoka on Tuesday that government forecasts still expect New Zealand's unemployment rate to come back down close to five percent.
Birch, in Japan for the Asian Development Bank annual meeting, was commenting on unemployment statistics published on May 6 showing the March quarter rate rising to 6.4 percent from 5.9 percent.
Birch said the recent increase was not unexpected and was still well down from its peak of nearly 11 percent in the early 1990s.
"The forecast is still very positive, for it to come back closer to five percent," Birch said.
